options.label: 北条司 (都会硬汉/熟女)
options.value: art style of Tsukasa Hojo, 1980s city pop aesthetic, realistic facial proportions with sharp nose and jawline, mature beauty, detailed cross-hatching shading, retro urban noir atmosphere

options.label: 桂正和 (恋爱/美少女/质感)
options.value: art style of Masakazu Katsura, focus on delicate female beauty and realistic anatomy, hyper-detailed rendering of clothing textures (especially denim and spandex), soft romantic lighting, expressive eyes

options.label: 鸟山明 (复古冒险/机械)
options.value: art style of Akira Toriyama, cel-shaded anime style, clean bold outlines, distinctive eye shape, detailed retro-futuristic machinery and vehicles, adventurous atmosphere

options.label: 贞本义行 (EVA风格/赛璐珞)
options.value: art style of Yoshiyuki Sadamoto, slender body proportions, sharp angular lines, clean cel shading, melancholic but stylish character design, 90s anime aesthetic

options.label: 大暮维人 (超大透视/光泽)
options.value: art style of Oh! Great (Ogure Ito), extreme dynamic perspective and foreshortening (fisheye lens), high contrast, glossy liquid-like skin texture, stylish mechanical details, chaotic but beautiful composition

options.label: 荒木飞吕彦 (JoJo立/硬朗)
options.value: art style of Hirohiko Araki, high-fashion dramatic posing, heavy black ink shading lines, sculpted muscle definition, bold surreal colors, intense facial expressions

options.label: 今石洋之 (扳机社/波普)
options.value: art style of Hiroyuki Imaishi (Studio Trigger), flat colors with neon palette, exaggerated angular geometry, erratic and energetic motion, pop-art comic aesthetic

options.label: 金亨泰 (油腻师姐/肉感)
options.value: art style of Hyung-tae Kim, distinctive Korean game illustration style, exaggerated anatomical curves (wide hips and thick thighs), thick oil-painting brushstrokes, warm glowing skin texture, dramatic rim lighting

options.label: ASK (极简/冷淡风)
options.value: art style of ASK (pixiv), clean flat shading, muted elegant color palette, minimalist composition, delicate and sharp facial features, cold and ethereal atmosphere

options.label: 新川洋司 (水墨/合金装备)
options.value: art style of Yoji Shinkawa, sumi-e ink wash painting style combined with pencil sketch, loose expressive brush strokes, monochromatic with artistic splashes of color, gritty concept art vibe

options.label: 村田莲尔 (复古未来/圆润)
options.value: art style of Range Murata, retro-futuristic steampunk aesthetic, soft round facial features, metallic textures mixed with leather, muted earthy color tones, highly detailed accessories

options.label: CLAMP (华丽/修长)
options.value: art style of CLAMP, elongated limb proportions, extremely intricate jewelry and clothing patterns, flowing hair, floating feathers and petals, shoujo manga gorgeousness
